items.title: Support exporting emissions reports as CSV
items.body: ### Problem Field teams share monthly emissions with auditors, but the dashboard only renders charts. Auditors re-type numbers from screenshots, which is slow and error-prone, and smaller organisations without an analyst give up on reporting entirely. ![screenshot](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1/chart.png) ```python report = meter.report(month=9) report.to_csv() # AttributeError ``` ### Proposal Add a `to_csv()` export next to the chart download button. [![CI](https://img.shields.io/badge/ci-passing-green)](https://ci.example.com)
